name: Tempo Budgets
description: Tempo Budgets is a Jira Data Center financial-planning product for folios, portfolios, costs, revenues, allocations, rates and project financial tracking. It is distinct from Tempo Financial Manager for Jira Cloud and is deployed inside a customer's own Jira Data Center environment.
agentUseSummary: Tempo Budgets cannot currently be connected as a Relay Marketplace provider. Tempo documents only an instance-local Data Center API that is a work in progress and may change without notice, while its Cloud API explicitly does not expose the Budgets folio data set.

blocked.label: Connect Tempo Budgets
blocked.description: Relay does not capture Jira Data Center basic-auth credentials or infer a customer's private instance routes.

blocked.label: Use Tempo Budgets API
blocked.description: Tempo warns that the Data Center API is a work in progress and only explicitly documented instance-local methods are intended for external use.

blocked.label: Use Cloud Budgets data
blocked.description: Tempo states that the Budgets folio data set is not exposed by its public Cloud REST API and that Financial Manager is a different app.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Tempo Budgets actions can be enabled without a stable provider-supported remote contract and a safe non-password authentication boundary.

runtimeSupport.description: No stable public Tempo Budgets remote API is available to mount.
No stable public Tempo Budgets remote API is available to mount.

providerSetup.blocker: Tempo Budgets is Data Center-only; its instance-local REST API is explicitly unstable, uses customer Jira authentication, and its folio data is not exposed by Tempo's public Cloud API.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Jira passwords, reuse browser sessions, probe a private Jira instance, or map this name to Financial Manager. Re-evaluate only if Tempo publishes a stable remote Budgets API with a provider-supported token or delegated authentication contract.

evidence.supports: Tempo labels the Budgets Data Center REST API a work in progress subject to significant change without advance warning, documents instance-local Jira routes and warns that only listed methods are intended for external use.
Tempo states that Budgets is a Jira Data Center product unavailable for Jira Cloud and that Financial Manager is a separate Cloud product with similar but non-identical capabilities.
Tempo states that the Budgets folio and portfolio data set is not exposed by the public Cloud REST API at apidocs.tempo.io.
